title: Earthy Dense Filipino Pork Bicol Express
description: A hearty and dense Filipino dish featuring prosciutto and pork, wrapped in ti leaves and perfect for a post-workout meal. This herbal and Whole30-friendly recipe is a unique twist on the classic Bicol Express.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine the pork shoulder, prosciutto, garlic, ginger, bird's eye chili, salt, and black pepper, and mix well.
Lay a ti leaf flat on a work surface and place about 1/2 cup of the pork mixture in the center of the leaf.
Fold the stem end of the leaf over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll the leaf into a tight package, and repeat with the remaining ingredients.
Place the ti leaf packages in a single layer in a large baking dish and pour in the coconut milk, fish sauce, and lime juice.
Cover the dish with aluminum foil and bake for 30 minutes.
Remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 20 minutes, or until the pork is cooked through and the ti leaves are tender.
Remove the dish from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
Serve the Bicol Express hot, garnished with sliced green onions and a sprinkle of salt.
